page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-16-highlssd is a memory-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores, operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 128 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It includes a massive 6442 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, but does not feature any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results indicate solid performance across memory and compute tasks. The server achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 10293.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 21549.51. Memory bandwidth is notable, reaching 1088.32 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 91.92 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. In terms of specialized workloads, the server demonstrates strong performance in LLM text generation for small models, processing 264.49 tokens/sec, while maintaining average performance for larger models and database operations.

The z3-highmem-16-highlssd offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial local storage and memory density without the overhead of a GPU. The inclusion of 6442 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside 128 GB of RAM makes it highly suitable for memory-intensive databases, large-scale caching layers, data indexing, and local file processing. The CPU's Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 support also make it a viable option for CPU-based machine learning inference and cryptographic workloads.
